Annual report/PIR goes to the Comptroller, not the Secretary of State

UT.name: Utah

office.value: Utah Department of Commerce, Division of Corporations and Commercial Code

filing_fee.note: Domestic LLC certificate of organization. The published schedule is Fiscal Year 2026, effective July 1, 2025; the Commerce LLC page also shows $59. A FY2027 fee hearing was held July 27, 2026 and a FY2027 schedule was not found, so recheck. File online at businessregistration.utah.gov with a UtahID.

name_reservation_fee.note: FY2026 schedule.

amendment_fee.note: FY2026 schedule, domestic and foreign entities.

annual_report_fee.note: Utah calls it the annual renewal. The $18 includes a $5 charge for the state's single sign-on portal (FY2026 schedule).

annual_report_due.value: One year from the date of registration, and annually thereafter

processing_online.note: Not confirmed on an official page; the state does not publish a processing time.

expedite.note: Expedited processing fee per filing (FY2026 schedule).

state_tax_registration.value: Utah Sales Tax License from the State Tax Commission for sellers with physical or economic presence in Utah; apply online at tap.utah.gov (Apply for a tax account, TC-69)
state_tax_registration.note: The page states no license fee and no deadline relative to starting business.

registered_agent.value: Required: a registered agent with a Utah street address

special_rules: Annual renewal must list at least one manager, member or other governing person
Fees are set by fiscal year and can change each July 1

VT.name: Vermont

office.value: Vermont Secretary of State, Business Services Division

filing_fee.note: Domestic LLC articles of organization. The state says there is no extra fee for online filing.

name_reservation_fee.note: Application for Reserved Name; renewal is also $25.

annual_report_fee.note: Vermont LLC annual report. LLCs file annually to maintain legal existence.

annual_report_due.value: Within three months after the end of the LLC's fiscal year on record
annual_report_due.note: Statute 11 V.S.A. § 4033(c); the Secretary of State annual report page says the same.

processing_online.value: Normally less than 1 business day
processing_online.note: Mailed filings take 7 to 10 business days.

state_tax_registration.note: Not confirmed on an official page.

registered_agent.value: Required: the LLC must designate and continuously maintain a designated office (it need not be in Vermont) and an agent for service of process under 11 V.S.A. § 1655
registered_agent.note: Agent qualifications and address rules are in § 1655, which was not read, so they are not stated here.

special_rules: Annual report required every year; fee $45
Online filing is the state's preferred method with no extra fee

VA.name: Virginia

office.value: Virginia State Corporation Commission, Clerk's Office

filing_fee.note: Same fee to file online or on Form LLC-1011. Statutory fee under Va. Code § 13.1-1005.

name_reservation_fee.note: Va. Code § 13.1-1005: application to reserve or renew a name.

annual_report_fee.note: Virginia LLC annual registration fee (the SCC does not call it an annual report fee). Paid to the SCC.

annual_report_due.value: By the last day of the month in which the LLC was organized or registered, every year

annual_report_penalty.value: $25 penalty if the registration fee is late for an LLC

processing_online.note: Not confirmed on an official page. The SCC says an online filing with no attachment gets a receipt and an acceptance email after checkout; filings with restricted words or attachments get a staff review first.

state_tax_registration.value: All new businesses register with Virginia Tax online (required since July 1, 2024); register for Retail Sales and Use Tax as an in-state dealer and Employer Withholding as needed
state_tax_registration.note: Form R-1 by mail only if you cannot register online. The pages list no fee and no deadline.

registered_agent.value: Required: a registered office in Virginia (may be a place of business) and a registered agent, who is a Virginia-resident individual (such as a member, manager, officer or Virginia State Bar member) or a business entity authorized in Virginia, with a business office identical to the registered office

special_rules: Annual registration fee of $50 is due every year by the last day of the formation month; $25 late penalty
Name with restricted words, or an attachment, triggers SCC review before acceptance

WA.name: Washington

office.value: Washington Secretary of State, Corporations and Charities Filing System

filing_fee.note: State filing fee. Online filing adds an online processing fee whose amount the state page does not state.

name_reservation_fee.note: Reserves the name for 180 days.

annual_report_fee.note: Washington annual report; the fee shown includes the online processing fee. Washington also requires a business license through the Department of Revenue.

annual_report_due.value: By the LLC's expiration date, the last day of the month it was formed; can be filed up to 180 days early

annual_report_penalty.value: $25 delinquency fee when status is Delinquent; reinstating a dissolved domestic LLC costs a $140 penalty plus annual report fees for each missed year

processing_online.note: The state publishes no standard processing time. Expedited filings are generally processed within three working days.

expedite.note: Per business entity, in addition to regular fees. Expediting by mail costs an additional $100 per entity.

state_tax_registration.value: Business license through the Department of Revenue's Business Licensing Service is required if you hire employees within 90 days, collect sales tax, or have gross income of $12,000 a year or more; online applications take about 10 business days
state_tax_registration.note: The license application fee varies; see the Department of Revenue instructions. Certain structures must file with the Secretary of State first.

registered_agent.value: Required: all businesses must designate a registered agent in Washington (commercial or noncommercial) and give the agent's email address, per RCW 23.95.415

special_rules: Business and Occupation (B&O) tax: a gross receipts tax with no deduction for expenses; rates vary by activity
B&O small business and multiple activities credits may reduce the tax
Initial Report (principal office and governors) due within 120 days of formation; no fee if filed with the Certificate of Formation, an added fee if filed later
Late annual report carries a $25 delinquency fee

WV.name: West Virginia
WV.formation_document: Articles of Organization of Limited Liability Company (Form LLD-1)

office.value: West Virginia Secretary of State (filed through the One Stop Business Portal)

filing_fee.note: $100 registration fee plus a $1.00 online processing fee that applies to all online filings. Fee is waived for veteran-owned entities (LLD-1) and may be waived for WV-resident young entrepreneurs ages 18 to 29.

name_reservation_fee.note: 120-day name reservation. This fee schedule is dated 'Effective November 18, 2019'; no newer schedule found.

annual_report_fee.note: West Virginia annual report: $25 plus the $1.00 online processing fee. Waived for veteran-owned entities for four years after formation (Form LLD-1).

annual_report_due.value: Every year between January 1 and June 30, starting the year after the year the LLC was registered

annual_report_penalty.value: Late annual report: $75 if received after June 30 (includes a $50 late fee); also risk of administrative dissolution or revocation

processing_online.note: Not confirmed on an official page; the state publishes no standard processing time.

expedite.note: Additional to the filing fee, business filings only. From the fee schedule dated Nov 18, 2019; the One Stop portal page confirms 1-hour, 2-hour and 24-hour options for a fee but not the amounts.

state_tax_registration.value: Business registration with the WV State Tax Department is required before commencing business activities, after Secretary of State approval; $30 business registration tax, and the Business Registration Certificate does not expire
state_tax_registration.note: Operating without a required registration can bring penalties of up to $50 a month.

registered_agent.value: Optional on the Articles ('if any'): the form says you may maintain an agent for service of process in West Virginia, who may be an individual resident, a corporation or another LLC

special_rules: Separate WV State Tax Department business registration ($30) in addition to Secretary of State filing
Online filings carry a $1.00 processing fee
Veteran-owned entities: registration fee waived and annual report fee waived for four years

WI.name: Wisconsin

office.value: Wisconsin Department of Financial Institutions (DFI)

filing_fee.note: Online filing. Paper filing is $170.

annual_report_fee.note: Wisconsin LLC annual report: $25 online, $40 on paper.

annual_report_due.value: During the calendar quarter of the LLC's registration anniversary: March 31, June 30, September 30 or December 31
annual_report_due.note: Due-date table also on the DFI annual report instructions (CORP5i).

annual_report_penalty.value: Failure to file may result in administrative dissolution
annual_report_penalty.note: The instructions state no late fee.

processing_online.note: Not confirmed on an official page; DFI gives no processing time. Online filers get an emailed confirmation.

expedite.note: Fees listed on the DFI fee page. The DFI FAQ says expedited requests are acted on by close of business the following business day.

state_tax_registration.value: Business Tax Registration (BTR) with the Department of Revenue for seller's permits, employer withholding and similar accounts; initial BTR fee is $20 (covers two years), renewal $10
state_tax_registration.note: No registration deadline is stated on the page. The online BTR application gives account numbers by email the same day.

registered_agent.value: Required: a registered agent at a registered office in Wisconsin; the agent must be a Wisconsin resident, the LLC cannot be its own agent, and the office must be an actual street address (no mailbox, P.O. box or answering service)

special_rules: Online formation costs $40 less than paper ($130 vs $170); annual report $15 less online ($25 vs $40)
Name must include 'limited liability company', 'limited company' or an abbreviation such as LLC

WY.name: Wyoming

office.value: Wyoming Secretary of State, Business Division

filing_fee.note: Fee schedule effective July 1, 2026; the schedule shows one fee for articles of organization, marked as fileable electronically. Online filing adds a credit card processing fee of 2.4% of the filing fee, minimum $1 (about $2.40), per WyoBiz.

annual_report_fee.note: Wyoming annual report license tax: the greater of $60 or two-tenths of one mill ($0.0002) per dollar of assets located and employed in Wyoming. $60 is the minimum; no separate LLC report fee or online fee is listed.

annual_report_due.value: Every year on the 1st day of the LLC's anniversary month of formation (an LLC formed January 15 is due January 1)

annual_report_penalty.value: No late fee is listed for LLCs on the fee schedule; reinstatement for tax is $100

processing_online.value: Active immediately when filed online
processing_online.note: Names beginning with the letter 'A' must be filed on paper for manual review (WyoBiz). Mailed out-of-state filings can take up to 15 business days.

expedite.note: Expedited filing review; not all documents qualify.

state_tax_registration.value: Sales tax license from the Excise Tax Division only if you sell taxable items and have physical presence or economic nexus in Wyoming; apply online through WYIFS (about two weeks)
state_tax_registration.note: Forming an LLC alone does not trigger the requirement. The page states no license fee and no deadline.

registered_agent.value: Required: a Wyoming resident individual (18 or older) or a business entity authorized in Wyoming, with a physical Wyoming address (no P.O. box, drop box or mail forwarding); the agent signs a Consent to Appointment

special_rules: Annual report license tax is the greater of $60 or $0.0002 per dollar of Wyoming assets
Names beginning with 'A' must be filed on paper for manual review
Annual report due on the 1st day of the anniversary month, not a fixed calendar date
